page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor featuring 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and external storage or other network resources.

Given the combination of 96 dedicated CPU cores and quad NVIDIA T4 GPUs, this instance is optimized for workloads such as machine learning inference, distributed deep learning, video transcoding, and high-performance computing tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bare-metal architecture eliminates virtualization overhead, maximizing the return on hardware resources for parallelized, GPU-dependent applications.
